name: What should I bring or wear for an assault bike training session at Cave Training?
description: Wear comfortable athletic clothes and supportive shoes. Bring a water bottle and an optional towel. Cave Training provides all necessary assault bikes.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring or wear for an assault bike training session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an assault bike training session at Cave Training, we recommend wearing comfortable athletic apparel that allows for a full range of motion. Closed-toe athletic shoes with good support are essential. Bring a water bottle to stay hydrated, as these workouts can be quite intense. A small towel might also be useful. You don't need any special equipment beyond that; we provide all the necessary assault bikes and ensure they are clean and well-maintained for your use.
